# Terms

* [Alpha](alpha.md) - A fully described, human-reviewed, fresh page.
* [Beta](beta.md) - Machine-confirmed and overdue by instant.
* [Gamma](gamma.md) - Unverified, generated without a date, never overdue.
* [Delta (deprecated)](delta.md) - Deprecated, with a replacement link.
* [Epsilon (deprecated)](epsilon.md) - Deprecated, with no replacement link.
* [Zeta](zeta.md) - Overdue by calendar date.
* [Eta](eta.md) - Unparseable recheck date and a bare verified mapping.
* [Theta](theta.md) - A recheck datetime without an offset.
